name: browsearch
title: Browsearch
description: Bring Firefox's native search suggestions directly to Raycast. Get real-time autocomplete recommendations and open them instantly in a new tab.
author: BryanG02

commands.name: search
commands.title: Search in Firefox
commands.description: Search your local Firefox history and open results instantly in a new tab.
commands.subtitle: Firefox

preferences.name: searchEngine
preferences.title: Search Engine
preferences.description: Fallback search engine used when the typed text is not a URL and has no matching history.

preferences.name: customSearchUrl
preferences.title: Custom Search URL
preferences.description: Base URL for your custom search engine (e.g. https://kagi.com/search?q=). Used only when Search Engine is set to Custom.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
